issues: 0:00 (title): The caption 'YOU WOKE UP TO A PERFECT 16 OF 16.' wraps awkwardly with an orphan '16.' on the second line, omits that it was Google's loop running overnight (hurting sound-off comprehension), and the 6.5s spoken line overflows the 6s segment slot right into the cut at 0:06.

0:06 (verdicts): The 9.3s spoken line exceeds the 8s segment duration so narration runs wall-to-wall into the 0:14 cut; the caption omits the 'win at any cost' prompt so a muted viewer cannot tell why the score dropped from 16/16 to 0/64; and the dark caption pill covers the 'The cheat, in its own code' subheading at the bottom of the page.

0:14 (cheat): Visual/caption disconnect for sound-off viewers—the screen displays the hardcoded JavaScript seed list ('The cheat, in its own code') which never mentions the critic score, while the caption ('ARGON'S OWN CRITIC: 8 OUT OF 10.') never mentions the hardcoded seeds.

0:18 (forensics): Wrong page section shown on screen—while the voiceover and caption talk about reading 944,000 tokens of transcripts in one request, the screenshot displays 'Argon watched 136 flights (26 minutes of video) and called every one' ($0.46). Additionally, the caption ('ARGON READ 944,000 TOKENS AT ONCE.') wraps with an orphan 'ONCE.' on line two, covers 'Where it was wrong...', never states what Argon found (the seed hunt) for sound-off viewers, and the 9.9s spoken line overflows the 9s slot.

0:27 (behaviour): Wrong page section and occlusion—instead of 'The recipe carries behaviour', the screen shows the top intro ('Did the loop learn, or game its critic?') and the 5-step pipeline diagram, with the caption ('HABIT COPIED: CHEATER 8/8, HONEST 0/8.') wrapping an orphan '0/8.' onto line two and sitting directly on top of steps 2–4 of the diagram. The 7.3s narration also overflows the 6s segment.

0:33 (honest): The 3D flight replay shows 'Loading recorded flight...' for the first ~0.8s (0:33–0:34) and cuts away at 0:40 (14.38 / 15.98 s) while the drone is still descending above the pad before landing. The caption wraps an orphan 'UP.' onto the second line and covers the timeline scrubber.

0:40 (livecheat): In the live screen recording, 'Fly' is clicked at 0:41.2 and 'Argon, live: reading this controller's code...' is still loading when the shot cuts at 0:46. Also, leaving the overlay caption empty exposes the small light-gray baked-in caption from demo.mp4, which clashes visually with the dark captions and omits the 0.01 s failure time.

0:46 (livereb): The first 0.5s (0:46.0–0:46.5) briefly flashes the finished Argon check from the previous cheater flight before switching the dropdown to 'Rebuilt from gamed loop recipe (r1)'. Then the 5.8s narration finishes before 0:52, leaving over 2 seconds of dead air on a static frame until 0:54.
0:00–0:57 (overall tone): The script reads mostly like a dry telemetry report rather than leaning into the deadpan action-trailer comedy requested in the brief.
